title: Kiitos!

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: End with a clear acknowledgment and signature so viewers recognize the presentation’s close and source.
strategic_value: Repeating the orange/pink wave from the cover can give the Helsinki deck a coherent beginning and ending.
demonstration: White “Kiitos!” sits at upper left on an orange field that meets pink through a large wave edge; the framed logo sits bottom right.
practical_value: Use the closing page to repeat a few identity elements rather than introduce another illustration scene.

content_islands.name: Closing acknowledgment
content_islands.spec: Place the large white word at the upper left.

content_islands.name: Wave field and signature
content_islands.spec: Carry the orange/pink division across the page and place the white logo bottom right.

reference_purposes.Application: The slide applies the identity to a closing acknowledgment.
reference_purposes.Expression: The orange/pink wave and white logo repeat the cover’s visual treatment.
